answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the pearl accrues. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the reef of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. So a dawn of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1f0i9.
